beats.text: Start with a task where an agent could take a consequential wrong step.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the opening architecture chapters to identify its state, permissions, and recovery needs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then use the pattern comparisons and cost discussion to examine plausible alternatives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final research agenda asks what evidence would justify greater autonomy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Agentic AI 2026 is valuable as a connected argument about accountable delegation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to decide which freedoms your system needs, and which boundaries make them usable.
